title: Public first-success instructions and stable capability references match a tested published release
claim: The Host Agent-first public tutorial names the exact published @opute/host-agent package version whose read-only package canary passed. Stable capability reference data uses the same package version and catalog revision. Each archived release reference is generated from its own immutable, allowlisted release catalog snapshot and remains discoverable in the sitemap and search index. Any unverified candidate is visibly labelled preview. The launcher requires and preserves one explicit opaque OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID and MCP_AUTH_TOKEN. Its local daemon ownership identity is reported separately and never substitutes for canonical Host Agent identity. Generated HTML addresses its stylesheet and client scripts using each asset's LF-normalized SHA-256 fingerprint, and CI rejects missing or stale fingerprints.
rationale: A successful source build, open health endpoint, or tool-name snapshot cannot prove that a visitor can install the published launcher, authenticate, discover tools, and read structured host facts. Matching release and catalog evidence prevents public instructions from silently describing a different artifact or runtime boundary.
owner: wunderous/host-agents owns public copy, catalog projection, npm launcher, and release evidence; wunderous/opute-site-deploy owns production deployment.

allowlisted catalog snapshots and versioned capability routes

exception: An unpublished or unverified candidate may be shown only with a visible Preview label. Stable tutorial or reference claims require matching package, source, catalog revision, and successful published read-only canary evidence.

revisionBehavior: Update the package version and recapture the allowlisted catalog when the release artifact or public descriptors change. The stable promotion script archives the prior stable catalog as site/context/release-archives/v<version>.json when the package version advances and refuses conflicting archive content. Archived snapshots are immutable, must include matching published read-only canary evidence, and drive their own versioned page, JSON download, search entry, and sitemap route. Stable promotion stores the exact package version, source SHA, catalog revision, canary run and attempt. CSS and client-script URL fingerprints change automatically with LF-normalized asset content; update the validator's asset allowlist and tests when that asset set changes. Recompute and review file anchors whenever an anchored authority changes.
